$comment: Firefox extensions — DECLARATIVE source of truth, mirrors brave-extensions.json.
Each entry is force-installed via Mozilla's enterprise policy mechanism:
policies.json → ExtensionSettings → installation_mode: force_installed
with install_url pointing at addons.mozilla.org/.../latest.xpi (always
latest version). Force-installed extensions can't be removed via the UI
(shows 'managed by your organization' badge).
Key differences from brave-extensions.json:
- Firefox uses a different addon ID format than Chrome:
email-style 'wakatime@wakatime.com'
- install_url points to AMO (addons.mozilla.org) not Chrome Web Store
- Some Brave extensions don't have Firefox counterparts (e.g. Anthropic
Claude has no published Firefox addon) — those are commented out below
pending verification from the user.
Adding/changing:
1. Find addon on https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/<slug>
2. Get the addon ID from `about:debugging` → This Firefox → installed
OR from the addon page's Manifest URL
3. Add entry below with id (UUID or email-style) + slug + name
4. build.sh switch + relaunch Firefox
